name: Old Town of Ghadamès
description: Ghadamès is an old oasis town in the Libyan Sahara, near the borders with Algeria and Tunisia, and is nicknamed the "pearl of the desert." Its whitewashed houses are built in tiers: storerooms below, family rooms above, and rooftop terraces for the women. Covered alleys link the houses and form a shaded, almost underground maze that keeps out the desert heat.
